title: BaseUnityPlugin got destroyed after awake, can't use update / onGUI
body:
### What happened?

"Start()", "Update()" and "OnGUI()" didn't get called ,
Found out the plugin class got destroyed .

### Steps to reproduce

1. create a plugin with UnityEngine.Debug.Log inside Awake(), Update() and OnDestroy()
2. add it into the plugin folder and run it
3. read the log as the plugin got destroyed, update() never get called

### BepInEx Distribution

Stable from GitHub
